name: nginx-multisite
description: Installs Nginx and configures three SSL-enabled virtual hosts with self-signed TLS certificates, enforces UFW firewall rules, applies sysctl security hardening, configures fail2ban, and hardens SSH.

name: cache
description: Installs and configures Memcached and Redis with password authentication, including a ruby_block post-processing workaround to strip deprecated Redis configuration directives for version compatibility.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Clones a FastAPI Python application from GitHub, sets up a Python virtual environment, provisions a PostgreSQL database and user, writes a .env configuration file, and registers a systemd service to run the application via uvicorn.
